answer: Full reward demands answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 58%. Because the sparrow pair is tracked in the vertex ledger, the onyx audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 121 identities means 121 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
